svg.title: Example: Skills Matrix
svg.desc: Worked example for a fictional team. A3 landscape skills matrix: team members by ten skills scored 0 to 3, wants-to-learn column, single points of failure, a learning plan, and a swarm-readiness checklist.
svg.text: See who can do what, where you rely on one person, and who will learn what, so the team can swarm.
Manage Flow · Team Capability · T-Shaped Skills · Reduce Single Points of Failure
SCORE 0–3 IN EACH CELL · SELF-ASSESSED, THEN DISCUSSED
Skills where only one person is at 2 or 3:
Skills where nobody is at 3 (no one to teach):
Every key skill has 2+ people at level 2
Pairing time is planned each iteration
Experts have time set aside to teach
New joiners have a learning buddy
“If one person was away for a month, what would stop?”
“What would you like to learn, and who could teach you?”
Manage Flow · Stop Starting, Start Finishing
